JUST IN: FAA clears Starship Flight 14, SpaceX's first attempt to put Starship into orbit.

The FAA issued and made effective license VOL 23-129 Rev 9.0 on Sep 26, per the signed license posted on the FAA's regulatory database.

• Window: Mon, Sep 28 at 7:15 a.m. CT (5:15 a.m. PT), 75 minutes
• Payload: 26 Starlink V3 satellites, first V3s into the constellation
• Flight: ~6 orbits at ~275 km, splashdown west of Chile
• License: adds "Initial order for licensed Starship reentry"

All 13 Starship flights so far flew suborbital. Monday is the first shot at orbit.

Just tested @grok @bot  in the Tesla.“Order my usual Starbucks.”

FSD drove. Grok confirmed the drink and total out loud. Placed the order. 

Ready when I pulled up. No phone. No tapping.

That’s the party trick. 

The real shift is the cabin becoming a workstation:

Inbox and calendar, hands-free  
Files, chats, and tasks while you roll  
Amazon / DoorDash / reservations  
Climate, music, calls, nav — all in the same conversation

Cars used to take you to work.
Now they do some of it on the way.

@Grok @bot is inside the car now. This is only the start.

I've quietly poured my heart and soul into something that's finally out today.

It's called "The Nyxie Show," a kids' show starring our real rescue pets Nyxie, Finn, Atreyu, and more of our crew. The stories come from their actual personalities and the funny, sweet things they do every day while educating viewers.

I write and produce every part myself with creative input from my wife, from the songs to the videos. My goal was simple: make something I'd be proud to put in front of my nieces, nephews, and friends' children so they can have fun and learn.

If you're a parent of a toddler or preschooler, this one's for you. Every episode mixes fun with real learning: ABCs, colors, numbers, how animals behave, and songs to help them fall asleep. Each is wrapped in a story with music I hope you'll enjoy too, not just tolerate on repeat.

The first music video is out now, and a new one drops every Friday at 8 AM PT on YouTube.

If you have little ones or know someone who does, I'd love for you to check it out, subscribe, and share it!

SpaceXAI’s Colossus supercomputer is scaling AI infrastructure to a massive level.

* Hundreds of thousands of GPUs across facilities in Tennessee and Mississippi, with gigawatt-scale power.
* The system trains advanced AI models including Grok.
* New footage shows dense server racks, massive cooling systems, industrial halls, and ongoing construction.
* The project also brings local jobs, tax revenue, water recycling, and grid infrastructure upgrades.

The infrastructure behind next-generation AI is getting enormous.

Starlink kits donated to the University of Zimbabwe to provide free campus internet.

* Local businessman Cosmas Mushininga donated the Starlink kits to support students, lecturers, teaching, learning, and research.
* The initiative expands access to reliable internet across the university.
* The donation adds to Zimbabwe’s broader efforts to expand connectivity through Starlink.

Starlink is helping bring high-speed internet closer to students across Zimbabwe.
